notes: It seems I messed up! Not only did I forget my flashlight, but I also took the wrong map with me!
This time, I will have to follow your instructions in the dark. I trust you to bring me to the end.
Perhaps the right map ended up with your neighbour instead... Why not ask? After all, peer-to-peer is the key!
